title: Queso for a Cause at Lebanon Pancheros!
seo_title: Queso for a Cause at Pancheros in Lebanon, MO
description: Queso for a Cause is a fundraiser dinner at Pancheros Mexican Grill where you eat a meal while supporting the Lebanon Area Foundation, which Pancheros will donate 10% of all sales during the event to. Family and friends are invited to come anytime during the event. It takes place Thursday, December 10, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM at 1539 S Jefferson Ave in Lebanon, MO.
address: 1539 S Jefferson Ave, Lebanon, MO 65536-3762, United States, Lebanon, MO
